messages:
alexa (partnerships): Quick sync — can we lock the Marketplace publish window? Need press slot, hero asset for microsite, and SI staging creds all aligned. Who's blocked?
amy (marketing): I have a tentative press slot Tues 03/30 09:00 PT. Waiting on final quotes from product. Draft hero + CTA is here: https://docs.redwood/marketplace/hero-draft (comments open).
matt (product): Confirmed we can provide the feature blurb and 2 screenshots. Need vector logo from partner and the official SKU name. ETA EOD Thu.
raj (SI - nexus): For our demo we need staging creds and a stable sample tenant. Can you host a shared demo account? Prefer: `https://staging-nexus.redwood-demo.com` and a service account with read-only keys.
amy (marketing): @raj we'll add a private demo link behind the partner gate. Who on infra can spin a tenant?
matt (product): @raj we can hand off a seeded tenant. Ops needs the exact graph size and sample queries though — send the checklist.
raj (SI - nexus): Sending checklist now: 1) demo tenant 2) sample data set (~500KB) 3) service account + token 4) redirect URI for OAuth demo. Also need a way to rotate creds — our security team requires 90-day rotation.
sam (legal): Heads up — partner has a press pre-approval clause. Need partner sign-off on the embargo copy and the joint quote before we publish. Share the embargo text by EOD Fri.
amy (marketing): Draft embargo copy here — please comment: "Redwood Inference and Nexus announce joint availability of..." Want to drop a partner quote. @sam can you review partner quote language?
sam (legal): I will review. If partner changes the quote, we require final approval 48h before publish.
alexa (partnerships): Action items so far: (1) matt provide screenshots + SKU + demo checklist -> Thu EOD, (2) amy finalize hero + embargo copy -> Fri EOD, (3) sam review legal -> Fri COB, (4) infra spin tenant + creds -> Raj to confirm. Any blockers?
raj (SI - nexus): One potential blocker — our compliance team needs the data residency note on the listing (EU region). Can you add region tag to the listing metadata?
matt (product): We can tag region in metadata. Will update the listing spec: `region: eu-west-1`.
amy (marketing): Marketing approval: hero image ok as long as we get high-res logo. Also want a short demo GIF (10s) for the landing hero. Can product/ops capture that during handoff?
matt (product): Yes — we'll record a 10s GIF during tenant handoff.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: marketplace-staging -> 2026-03-29T02:00:00Z (dry run) :rocket:
alyx (partnerships): sorry typo — meant alexa.
alexa (partnerships): Thanks @deploy-bot — so timeline looks: dry run 03/29, partner final sign-off 03/29 COB, press launch 03/30 09:00 PT. If anyone needs to shift, call now.
sam (legal): If partner sign-off slips past 03/29 12:00 PT we should delay press by 24h. Marking as risk.
amy (marketing): Noted. I'll prepare a contingency tweet/short statement for +24h.
raj (SI - nexus): We'll prioritize internal sign-off. I'll update by EOD today with compliance approval or escalate.
matt (product): Upload location for assets: `s3://redwood-marketplace/staging/assets/1719990022/` — I'll put screenshots + GIF there and ping when ready.
amy (marketing): Perfect. Also need hero alt-text for accessibility — add to the upload manifest.
matt (product): will do.
alexa (partnerships): Great. Final asks before I close: @raj confirm rotation window for creds (90d ok?), @sam sign-off target Fri COB, @amy confirm hero final by Fri EOD.
raj (SI - nexus): 90d rotation accepted. I'll confirm final by 18:00 PT.
sam (legal): Reviewing embargo copy now, aiming to finish by Fri COB.
amy (marketing): Hero locked to Fri EOD.
alexa (partnerships): Awesome — closing this thread. I'll post a summary doc with the checklist and owners in the doc linked above. :white_check_mark:
